challenged_mechanism: After the exact independent-copy pair-law identity, move absolute value through the sum-variable integral and combine any fixed finite number of per-coordinate L2/Linfinity estimates by time Holder.
counterexample_scope: Already A=I_3 with iid cap-one positive-axis scale-mixture inputs.
summary: For f_N=(1/N) sum_{k=1}^N R_k^{-1} 1_[R_k,2R_k], R_k=L^k, L>=4, m=f_N*f_N satisfies T_p=int m^(1-1/p)u^(-1/p) >= [6^(-1/p)/(2-1/p)] N^(-2+2/p)(N-1)^(2-1/p). Hence every fixed-coordinate Holder certificate pi prod T_{p_j} with sum 1/p_j=1 grows at least linearly in N, even though the true diagonal collision integral is <=2pi^2. The loss is caused by taking absolute values before joint sum-variable aggregation. This does not refute QFORM.
